v: pu॰ A + naha--GaY । 1 banDe 2 dErvye Anahyate apasaraRa pratiroDena baDyate viRmutrAdi anena A + naha + karaRe GaY । 3 viRmUtraroDasADane vEdyakokte rogaBede “AmaM SakfdvA nicitaM krameRa BUyovibadDam viguRAnilena । pravarttamAnaM na yayAsvamenaM vikAramAnAhamudAharanti” mA॰ ni॰ । vAtAdidozAnuktvA sTAnaviSezASrayatvena tezAM rogaviSezajanakatvamuktaM suSru॰ । “ata UrdDvaM sTAnanasaMSrayaM vakzyAmaH । evaM kupitAstAMstAn SarIrapradeSAnAgatya tAMstAn vyADIn janayanti । te yadodarasanniveSaM kurvvanti tadA gulmavidraDyudarAgnisaNgAnAhavisUcikAtisArapraBftIn janayanti” । “AnAhArttaM tatodfzwvA tatsEnyamasuKArditam । pitaraM duHKitaM dfzwvA sukanyedamaTAbravIt” BA॰ va॰ pa॰ 122 a॰ ।

constipation, Suśr.; MBh.
length, L.
a: आनाहः — 1 Binding. --2 Suppression of urine, constipation, epistasis. --3 Length (especially of cloth).

स्त्रियां बहुत्वे वस्त्रस्य दशाः स्युर्वस्तयोर्द्वयोः। दैर्घ्यमायाम आरोहः परिणाहो विशालता॥

m: 1. आ-नाय्य mfn. to be brought near

m: आन्धा-स्वर n. a partic. mode of singing, Drāhy.

v: na॰ anDIgunA fziBedena dfzwaM sAma--aR । tftIyasavane geye ArBavapavamAnasUktagate sUktaBede tacca sUktam UhagAne 1 pra॰ 11 ka॰ paWitam tacca sAma॰ sa॰ BA॰ darSitam yaTA “SyAvaSvAnDIgave'nuzwuvAneye graTyate'Ta vA । pureva liNgaM jagatI caturviMSati--kIrttanam । idamAmnAyate “paYcaCandA AvApaH ArBavaH pavamAnaH saptasAmA, gAyatrasaMhite gAyatrye tfce BavataH, SyAvASvAnDIgave AnuzwuBe tfce BavataH, uzRihi SaPam, kakuBi pOzkalam, kAvamantyaM jagatIzu” iti । ayamarTaH asti tftIyasavane pavamAnaH ArBavasaMjYakaH, tasmin paYca sUktAni, sapta sAmAni, “svAdizWayA nadizWA” ityekaM sUktam (u, 3 pra, 15), tasmin gAyatryastisra fcaH tAsu “gAyatram” “saMhitam” (u, 1 pra, 8) ceti dve sAmAnI, “purojitI Sro anDasaH” iti sUktAntaram (u, 1 pra, 18) tatrEkAnuzwubuttare dve gAyatryO tAsu “SyAvASvam” (U, 1 pra, 11) “AnDIgavam” (u, 2 pra, 11) ceti dve sAmanI, “indramacCa sutA” ityaparaM sUktam (U, 1 pra, 18), tasminuzRihastisraH tAsu “SaPam” sAma, “pavasva maDumattama” iti pragATaH (u, 1 pra, 16), tasmin pUrvvA kakup, uttarA paNktiH । tatra “pOzkalam” (U, 1 pra, 9) sAma, “aBipriyARi pavate ca nohita” ityantyaM sUktam (u, 1 pra, 19), tatra tisrojagatyaH tAsu “kAvam” (U, 1 pra, 13) sAma” ।
m: आन्धीगव n. (fr. अन्धी-गु), ‘seen i.e. composed by the Ṛṣi Andhīgu’, N. of several Sāmans, Lāṭy. iv, 5, 27; TāṇḍyaBr.; Nyāyam.

m: आ-√ नी P. -नयति (1. pl. आ-नयामसि, AV. v, 25, 8; Impv. 2. sg. आ-नय, 3. sg. आ-नयतु; pf. आ-निनाय, AV. v, 17, 2, and आ-निनाय, RV. viii, 21, 9 ; inf. -नेतवै, ŚBr. ii, 1, 14, 16) Ā. (1. sg. -नये, R.) to lead towards or near; to bring, carry to a place (acc. or loc.); to fetch, RV.; AV.; SV.; ŚBr.; MBh.; R.; Śak. &c.; (perf. periphr. -नयामास, MBh. iii, 2282) to cause to bring or fetch; to bring back or take back, MBh.; R.; to pour in, mix in RV.; VS.; ŚBr. &c.; to bring any one to, reduce to any state, MBh.; to deduce, calculate; to use, employ, prove: Caus. P. -नाययति, to cause to be brought or fetched or led near, MBh.; R.; Ragh.; Kathās. &c.: Desid. -निनीषति, to intend or wish to bring near, BhP. x, 89, 42.
a: आनी — {c1c} P. 1 To bring, fetch; भुवनं मत्पार्श्वमानीयते Ś. 7. 8; तेषामुदकमानीय Ms. 3. 210. --2 To bring on, produce, cause; आनिनाय भुवः कंपं R. 15. 24. --3 To lead towards or near, convey. --4 To mix in. --5 To reduce or lead to any condition; वशं आनी to reduce to subjection. --6 To lead off, divert. --Caus. To cause to bring (with instr. of person who brings); R. 12. 12, 15. 74.

annamayAmuKyAtmapravAhapatitatvAt । aTApi syAtsarvAntaratvAdAnandamdayomuKya evAtmeti, na syAtpriyAdyavayavayogAcCArIratvaSravaRAcca । muKTaScedAtmA syAt na priyAdisaMsparSaH syAt iha tu “tasya priyameva Sira” ityAdi SrUyate । SArIratvaYca SrUyate । “tasyEkaevaSArIra AtmA yaH pUrvasyeti” । tasya pUrvasya vijYAnamayasyEkaeva SArIra AtmA yaeza Anandamaya ityarTaH । na ca saSarIrasya sataH priyApriyasaMsparSIvArayituMSakyaH । tasmAt saMsAryyevAnandamaya AtmAityevaM prApte idamucyate । paraeva Anandamayo Bavitumarhati kutaH? vikAraSabdAt । prakftivacanAdayamanyaH Sabdo vikAravacanaH samaDigata Anandamaya iti mayawovikArArTatvAt tasmAdannamayAdiSabdavadvikAravizaya evAyamAnandamayaSabda iti cenna prAcuryyArTe'pi mayawaH smaraRAt “tatpratikftavacane mayaqiti” (pA॰) pracuratAyAmapi hi mayaw smaryyate । yaTAnnamayo yajYa iti annapracura ucyate । AnandapracuratvaYca brahmaRaH manuzyatvAdAraByottarasmimnuttarasmin sTAne SataguRa Ananda ityuktvA brahmAnandasya niratiSayatvAvaDAraRAt tasmAtprAcuryyArTe mayaw । “tadDetuvyapadeSAcca” sU॰ । itaSca prAcuryyArTe mayaw yasmAdAnandahetutvaM brahmaRovyapadiSati SrutiH “eza hyevAnandAyatIti” । AnandayatItyarTaH । yohyanyAnAnandayati sa pracurAnanda iti prasidDaM Bavati yaTA loke yo'nyezAM DanitvamApAdayati sa pracuraDana iti gamyate tadvat । tasmAtprAcuryyArTe'pi mayawaH samBavAdAnandamayaH paraeva AtmAH । “mAntravarRikameva ca gIyate” sU॰ । itaScAnandamayaH paraevAtmA yasmAdu “brahmavidApnoti param” ityupakramyahi “satyaM jYAnamanantaM brahma” ityasminmantre yadbrahmaprakftaM satyajYAnAnantaviSezaRErnirDAritaM, yasmAdAkASAdikrameRa sTAvarajaNgamAni BUtAnyajAyanta, yacca BUtAni sfzwvA tAnyanupraviSya guhAyAmavasTitaM sarvAntaraM, yasya vijYAnAyA'nTo'ntara Atmeti prakrAntaM, tanmAntravarRikameva brahmeha gIyate “yo'nyontara AtmAnandamaya” iti । mantrabrAhmaRayoScEkArTatvaM yuktam aviroDAt । anyaTA hi prakftahAnAprakftaprakriye syAtAM, na cAnnamayAdiByEvAnandamayAdanyontaraM AtmA'BiDIyate etannizWEva ca sEzA BArgavI vAruRI vidyA “Anando brahmetivyajAnAditi” । tasmAdAnandamayaH paraevAtmA” SA॰ BA॰ । 2 Anandapracure tri॰ sarvvAyAsaSUnyasuzuptyavasTApanne 3 AnandamayakozABimAnini jIve ca । “kAcidantarmuKrAvfttirAnandaprativimbaBAk । puRyaBoge BogaSAntO nidrArUpeRa jAyate । kAdAcitkItyatInAtmA syAdAnandamayo'vyayam । vimbaBUtoya Ananda AtmAsO sarvvadA sTitaH” paYcada॰ ukteH jIvasya pAramArTikAnandarUpaparAtmasvarUpatve'pi suzuptO tasya sPuraRe'pi ca svalpakAlikatvAt brahmAnandavE lakzaRyam । striyAM NIp । sAca 4 durgAmUrttiBede strI॰ ।
